source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: As the Fight phase begins, each enemy unit that is in Engagement Range of at least one unit with this ability takes a Battle-shock test. In addition, this unit's models get a +1 bonus to Hit rolls for melee attacks against a Battle-shocked unit.
